_about: The Universal Transfer-Matrix Record of each wave model (Companion Part 228; F221): S the symbolic sequence, H the wave equation, T the transfer matrix, its matrix group, I the dynamical or topological invariant, P the predictions and observables, E the evidence.

models.S: the Fibonacci word, a -> ab, b -> a
models.P: spectrum, gap labels, scaling (MF-131, MF-132, MF-158)

models.S: the Fibonacci word on the bonds
models.H: t_n psi_(n+1) + t_(n-1) psi_(n-1) = E psi_n

models.S: the Fibonacci word on the layers
models.T: [[cos d, (i/n) sin d], [i n sin d, cos d]]
models.group: SL2(C), real form SL2(R) by diag(1, i)

models.S: the Fibonacci word on the layers
models.H: the acoustic wave equation at normal incidence
models.T: [[cos d, i Z sin d], [i sin d / Z, cos d]]
models.group: SL2(C), real form SL2(R) by diag(1, i)
models.I: as for light with n for 1/Z (MF-152)

models.S: the Fibonacci word with its phason
models.H: the Kraus family of smooth potentials
models.T: the Bloch Hamiltonian on the torus of k and the phason
models.I: the Chern number C = -q (topological, not dynamical)
models.P: the pumped particle number per cycle (MF-154; PR-009)

models.T: to be derived; a two-component reduction to be tested
